reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin that persists and restores sidebar layout, details-panel visibility, and non-bottom conversation scroll positions across restarts.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 自动持久化并恢复侧边栏布局、详情面板状态和对话滚动位置。
summaries.en: Automatically persists and restores DSH Web GUI sidebar layout, details-panel state, and conversation scroll positions.

capabilities: Persists sidebar, details-panel, and conversation-scroll state in the DSH settings file
Reads DSH layout and session state from the browser interface
Restores sidebar dimensions, panel visibility, and conversation scroll position using DSH layout APIs and synthetic pointer events
